messages:
Maria (CSM): @here kicking off Hearthly onboarding — quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, timelines, and how we'll capture feedback. Goal: core UX flows in prod sandbox by day 21, 30-day adoption checkpoint, renewal flag at 90d. :wave:
Omar (Customer): thanks Maria. I'll be the PM on our side. Main contacts: Lina (engineering), Priya (ops).
Ava (Success Eng): noted. I'll run weekly enablement sessions (Thurs 11am PT) and own the playbook docs.
Diego (Solutions): I'll own the connector work and schema mapping. Need access to Hearthly dev org and a sample webhook by EOD Friday. @Omar can you share?
Omar (Customer): sharing now — .zip attached in email. Will add Lina to this thread.
Samir (Enablement): I'll prepare a 45m tailored walkthrough + 15m Q&A focused on observability and cost controls. Proposed milestones: day 7 infra smoke test, day 14 inference perf baseline, day 21 prod sandbox signoff.
Maria (CSM): solid. Success criteria (provisional): 1) sandbox can serve 95th pctile latency < 1200ms on test load, 2) key flows return acceptable quality on our eval set (pass rate >= 90%), 3) integration docs + runbook live, 4) 10 internal users trained. Agree?
Ava (Success Eng): agree with metrics, will add runbook checklist items (auth, rollout toggle, fallback).
Diego (Solutions): FYI fallback model will be a lighter quantized variant — I'll stage it in Dedicated pool. Estimate 2 days to wire up routing policy.
Omar (Customer): risk note — renewal review happens at day 90 and budget signoff impacted if adoption < 40% of target. We need usage signal by day 30 to unblock procurement.
Maria (CSM): noted. Mitigations: 1) early beta with product team to drive internal usage, 2) weekly adoption report to exec sponsor, 3) canary rollout to 5% of traffic day 21.
Ava (Success Eng): for feedback capture — we'll use a short in-app survey + a shared Google form and a biweekly QA session. I'll own collating responses and tagging issues (severity/impact).
Samir (Enablement): also recommend a short eval harness (prompt set) integrated into CI so we can detect regressions post-deploy. I can scaffold it by day 14.
Diego (Solutions): request: access to their sample logs and expected SLOs. Also need the list of third-party connectors to test (Stripe, Zendesk?).
Omar (Customer): yes Stripe + Zendesk. I'll drop credentials into the secure share and add Lina and Priya.
onboard-bot: Reminder: onboarding runbook template available at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboarding-template — please copy to Hearthly folder.
Maria (CSM): action items recap: 1) Diego to request dev org/webhook (due: Fri), 2) Samir to scaffold eval harness (due: day 14), 3) Ava to schedule weekly enablement cadence (calendar invites today), 4) Omar to add Lina/Priya and share creds (due: EOD), 5) Maria to send kickoff summary + success metrics doc (today).
Omar (Customer): sounds good, I'll start invites and share creds today.
Ava (Success Eng): invite received — adding internal task board and initial slide deck for enablement.
Maria (CSM): thanks all — I'll post a short 1-pager and ping exec sponsor. We'll reconvene next Thurs after first enablement session. :thumbsup:
